stimulus: Bangladesh is a free land but she is beset (a) ⎯⎯ many problems. The use of poly bags is very dreadful. Recently it has become (b) ⎯⎯ great threat (c) ⎯⎯ our environment. The used poly bags also destroy (g) ⎯⎯ fertility of our soil. Our government has already banned the production (h) ⎯⎯ poly bags. Yet some greedy and (i) ⎯⎯ dishonest businessmen are producing the bags (j) ⎯⎯ their own interest.
